title: Set Cover by cover budget
task: Can at most k of the given sets cover U?
encoding: An explicitly listed finite universe U, a family of subsets of U, and a nonnegative integer k.

qualifications: The theorem also holds under k ≤ μ(r) for each nondecreasing unbounded function μ as in the source.

sources.locator: Theorem 3.5, pp. 225–227 (earlier bound without a parameter factor)

reader.label: Sublinear exponent in the candidate count

bounds.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm solves Set Cover within the stated running time.

qualifications: The source states this bound under the positive-rate SNP premise, which follows from ETH by sparsification.
The theorem also holds under k ≤ μ(M) for each nondecreasing unbounded function μ as in the source.

reader.label: Sublinear exponent in the full encoding length

bounds.statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm solves Set Cover within the stated running time.

reader.boundContext: The cover budget k. Here f denotes arbitrary total computable parameter function, r denotes number of sets, M denotes complete source encoding length.

recoveryDispositions.reason: The candidate count r can be smaller than the full encoding length M. The exact source comparison does not establish the bound measured only in M.
